text:
Emma: Quick note from customer calls: two high-priority asks for model cutovers — (A) a short billing grace/credit window during migrations, and (B) an in-console compat signal for any shim used. Can we scope MVP?

Ravi: Billing reconciliation is doable but needs a reconciliation job + flag in routing ledger. Estimate ~2-3 dev wks. We can do a manual credit flow first.

Sofia: For compat signal we can run a small A/B sample (200 queries) and show a "quality delta" badge (green/orange/red). Its fast and informative; full harness later.

Priya: CS prefers a 14-day credit window and an easy rollback playbook. If we offer manual credits + a playbook we reduce churn risk.

Nate: Ops: mirror routing at 1% traffic for samples. Add kill-switch and latency alerts.

Emma: Proposed MVP: (1) quality-delta badge + sample mirror @1% (manual toggle), (2) customer playbook + manual credit process. Automate credits/reconciliation in next sprint. Owners: Ravi infra, Sofia eval, Priya comms, Nate ops. Ship criteria: badge visible on model page, playbook template in docs, mirror toggle available. Sync Fri 9am to sign-off.

Ravi: I'll open infra tickets and draft a lightweight estimate endpoint for the console.

Sofia: I'll commit a sampling notebook and badge rules (thresholds) into kits/migration-harness.

Priya: I'll draft playbook/email and rollback script.

Emma: Thanks team :thumbsup:
